notes.title: Regional Pricing Changes
notes.content:
Users in a number of countries may or may not have noticed that the price of Alansya Chronicles: Fleeting Iris Ren'Py Edition. After careful back and forth discussion with Heaven Studios, a decision was made to change the regional pricing for a number of countries.

For example, previously the game was R$59.99 in Brazil but it has now been changed to R$43.99. In Thailand, it was ฿400.00 but now is ฿275.00.

In total, the countries effected are: Brazil, Japan, Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam, Korea, Mexico, Poland, India, Chile, Peru, Columbia, South Africa, Kazakhstan, Costa Rica, Uruguay. Also, regional specific pricing covering CIS, SASIA, LATAM countries has also been affected.

While the intent is not necessarily to set a precedent, we support the developer's decision to lower the price of their game in these countries so that more fans are able to fully enjoy this version of Fleeting Iris.

As always thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Explanation Regarding Differences In This Release
notes.content:
We hope everyone has been enjoying the release of Fleeting Iris: Alansya Chronicles Ren'Py Edition. It is entirely possible that there are some users who may be confused as to the difference between the RPGMaker version of the game and this new release that's built in the visual novel engine, Ren'Py. This news post is here to answer any questions folks may have.

Content-wise, there is no difference between the RPGMaker and Ren'Py versions of Fleeting Iris: Alansya Chronicles. For users worried that there would be content differences, there is certainly nothing to worry about here. The major difference is in the gameplay experience itself.

If you prefer the resource management aspect of exploring and experiencing everything Heaven City has to offer, then the recommendation is the RPGMaker version of the game. 

For users that prefer a more streamlined gameplay experience that a visual novel would provide, then the Ren'Py version is the one you want. Also keep in mind that the Ren'Py version does not have the screen resolution limitations that the RPGMaker version had so it is an experience with better image quality and screen resolution.

If you have any other questions or want to learn more about Fleeting Iris: Alansya Chronicles, don't hesitate to join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/0112SmRpXnz38MSkp]Heaven Studios Discord server[/url] for all the latest information!
